contract_conditioned_faults.zero_current_discount_rate_and_payment_f: PV and nominal cash mistake monthly base rent for the full periodic payment by omitting the payment-frequency factor.
contract_conditioned_faults.positive_current_discount_rate: PV uses payments-in-advance timing and nominal cash applies a one-period discount.
contract_conditioned_faults.positive_interest_schedule: Interest uses nominal annual/12 instead of the contractual effective monthly rate.
contract_conditioned_faults.depreciation: Rolling remaining-life charge includes an extra period.
